metaTitle: Custom LED Light Magnets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom LED light magnets for your next event or promotion. Functional and memorable branded giveaways from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom LED light magnets combine the practicality of a fridge magnet with the utility of a small flashlight. Perfect for trade shows, safety kits, or emergency preparedness giveaways, these promotional products ensure your logo stays visible even in the dark. Choose from battery-operated designs with a simple press-to-light feature, ideal for key chains or office use. Decorate with your company imprint using pad printing or laser engraving for a sleek, professional finish.
heroAltText: Custom LED light magnets with company logo, featuring a press-to-light function for emergency use
